# Cranach Catalog Finder 1.0.2
This release adds two client-ready document formats modeled on Cranach's existing sales materials:
- branded landscape proposals with a cover, contents, grouped product pages, selected finish, quantity, price, and closing page - portrait sales quotations with customer details, room groupings, quantities, discounts, shipping, totals, order notes, and standard terms - editable commercial details for every selected catalog product, while keeping the existing high-resolution image and combined catalog PDF exports - a refreshed, export-free catalog baseline whose reviewed product data is unchanged and whose registration timestamp now remains stable across launches
Every document is produced locally from the reviewed catalog. Saved packages, catalog corrections, and prior exports remain available after the update.
